transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. I, um... I hope I'm not wasting your time today. I just... well, I came in because things have been a little, you know, stressful at my apartment. 

I try to be a good neighbor, I really do, but... I know the people in my building have been watching my comings and goings. And they've been, um, slipping notes about me to the front office. Everybody keeps telling me I'm wrong, that they're just regular routine notices taped to the doors, but... well, I just know what's going on. 

I really don't want to sound difficult or like I'm complaining, I just... I didn't know what else to do. I hope it's okay that I came in to talk about that? Am I explaining it alright?
Have you ever heard voices, whispers, or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

Oh, um... no. No, I haven't heard anything like that. Just... just the regular building sounds, you know, like the pipes clanking or people walking upstairs. But no voices or whispers or anything unusual like that. 

I really try to keep a clear head about things, I promise. I hope that's... I hope that's the right kind of answer? I'm trying my best to give you the information you need, I just don't want to make it sound like I'm, well, making things up. Am I doing okay with your questions so far?
How long has this situation with your neighbors watching you and leaving notes been going on?

Well, um... it hasn't been forever, I promise. I really don't want you to think I'm the type of person who just sits around making a fuss all the time. I'd say... maybe it's been going on for about a year and a month now? Give or take a little bit. 

I really tried to just ignore it for the longest time, you know, so I wouldn't be a bother to anyone in the building. I always try to be a good tenant. Is that... does that answer your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right details.
